contributing_factors.description: Slope angle of 36.5° promotes gravitational shear stress along weathered basalt joints.
48h cumulative rainfall of 212.0mm with 84% soil wetness has degraded basal soil suction.
Within 25m of engineered road/rail cutting lacking toe retaining stabilization.

precautions: Evacuate vulnerable toe settlements and avoid mountain road cuts immediately.
Halt tourism access to waterfalls and low-lying escarpment viewing points.
Authorities to stage NDRF / SDRF teams and deploy heavy earthmovers to Bhor Ghat.
